name: Bloodied Gold
source:
A visit to my brother shouldn't be so exciting. I know his shenanigans already. Someone wanting to show ME, how he is suddenly going mad?

Now that is an interesting prospect I can't miss. A bird needs to do some house cleaning after being away for so long, afterall.

[From [url=https://peppekz.itch.io/bloodied-gold]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
拜访我的兄弟不应该那么令人兴奋。我已经知道他的诡计了。有人想让我看看他怎么突然发疯了？

现在，这是一个我不能错过的有趣前景。毕竟，鸟儿在离开这么长时间后，需要做一些房屋清洁工作。

[来自[url=https://peppekz.itch.io/bloodied-gold]Itch.io[/url]]
